vocabulary.meaning_en: 1) the answer to a yes/no question; 2) not any (before a noun with no article)
vocabulary.example: He had no reason for being late.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the word that makes a verb or sentence negative
a sentence or word that says no
vocabulary.example: "I am not happy" is a negative.

vocabulary.meaning_en: two negative words in one sentence (wrong in standard English)
vocabulary.example: "We don't have no time" is a double negative.
He had no reason for being late.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you play or compete against

vocabulary.example: We do not have enough time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a helping verb: do, be, have, can, could...
vocabulary.example: In "I do not know", "do" is an auxiliary verb.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a question you answer with yes or no
vocabulary.example: "Would you like some cake?" is a yes/no question.
No and not are not just memorization; there are rules.

fine_lines.title: no vs not
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في كثير من اللغات كلمة واحدة للنفي، أما في الإنجليزية فهناك no و not. no: جواب سؤال نعم/لا، وقبل اسم بدون أداة. not: مع الفعل، وقبل اسم معه أداة (a/the)، وقبل many / any / much / enough. لا تقل I no happy بل I am not happy.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Many languages have one word, but English has two. "No": to answer a yes/no question, and before a noun with no article. "Not": with verbs, before a noun with an article (a/the), and before many / any / much / enough. Say "I am not happy", not "I no happy".

fine_lines.title: no reason vs not a reason
fine_lines.explanation_ar: إذا لم توجد أداة نستعمل no: no reason. إذا وُجدت أداة نستعمل not: not a reason.
fine_lines.explanation_en: No article → no: "no reason". With an article → not: "not a reason".

examples.sentence: He had no reason to be late.
That is not a good reason.

expressions.phrase: No, I don't want any cake.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite negative answer to an offer.
expressions.example: "Would you like some cake?" "No, I don't want any cake, thank you."

expressions.phrase: We do not have enough time.
expressions.meaning_en: There is less time than we need.
expressions.example: Hurry up! We do not have enough time.

expressions.meaning_en: The correct negative of "I am happy".
expressions.example: I am not happy with my test result.

grammar.title: Use "no" to answer yes/no questions
grammar.explanation_ar: عند الإجابة عن سؤال جوابه نعم أو لا نقول no (وليس not)، ثم نفصل بفاصلة ونكمل الجملة المنفية.
grammar.explanation_en: To answer a yes/no question, say "no" (not "not"), then a comma and the negative sentence.
examples: "Would you like some cake?" "No, I don't want any cake."

grammar.title: Use "no" before a noun without an article
grammar.explanation_ar: نضع no قبل اسم ليس معه a أو the، حتى لو كان قبله صفة: no reason, no worthy opponents.
grammar.explanation_en: Put "no" before a noun with no article, even with an adjective: no reason, no worthy opponents.
examples: He had no reason for being late.
There is no milk in the fridge.

grammar.title: Exceptions: not with many, any, much, enough
grammar.explanation_ar: لا نستعمل no مع many و any و much و enough، بل نستعمل not مع الفعل: I do not have enough money.
grammar.explanation_en: Don't use "no" with many, any, much or enough. Use "not" with the verb: "I do not have enough money."
examples: We do not have enough time.
I don't have many friends here.

grammar.title: Use "not" before a noun with an article
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا كان قبل الاسم أداة (a/an/the) نستعمل not: This is not a house.
grammar.explanation_en: If the noun has an article (a/an/the), use "not": "This is not a house."
examples: This is not a house. It's a box.
That is not the right answer.

grammar.title: "Not" makes verbs negative
grammar.explanation_ar: not تنفي الأفعال، خاصة مع الأفعال المساعدة والأفعال الناقصة: do not like, could not go, is not here. no لا تنفي الأفعال.
grammar.explanation_en: "Not" makes verbs negative, especially with auxiliary and modal verbs: do not like, could not go, is not here. "No" cannot do this.

grammar.title: No double negatives
grammar.explanation_ar: لا نجمع no و not (أو كلمتي نفي) في الجملة نفسها، فهذا نفي مزدوج خاطئ: We don't have no time ✗ → We don't have any time ✓. لكن يمكن قول No, I'm not... لأن الفاصلة تفصل بين الفكرتين.
grammar.explanation_en: Don't put no and not (two negatives) in one sentence: "We don't have no time" ✗ → "We don't have any time" ✓. "No, I'm not..." is fine because a comma separates the ideas.

questions.question: "He had ___ reason for being late."
questions.explanation_en: Noun without an article: no reason.

questions.question: "This is ___ a house. It's a box."
questions.explanation_ar: قبل اسم معه أداة a نستعمل not.

questions.question: "We do ___ have enough time."
questions.explanation_ar: not تنفي الفعل، و no لا تأتي مع enough.
questions.explanation_en: "Not" makes the verb negative; "no" can't go with "enough".

questions.question: "Would you like some cake?" "___, thank you."
questions.explanation_en: Answer to a yes/no question: No.

questions.question: Which sentence has a double negative (wrong)?
Which word can NOT come after "no"?
questions.explanation_ar: enough من الاستثناءات: نقول not enough.
questions.explanation_en: "Enough" is an exception: we say "not enough".
